title: Elite: The Bargain Opens: First Pressure
description: The Bargain Opens unfolds across black iron court with volcanic glass aisles and ember chain channels, pushing a 5-Titan Infernal Dominion squad to prove aggression, debuffs, pulls, execution, burn pressure, power through risk. without violating established Realm canon.
lore: The Bargain Opens: First Pressure advances Cinders of Dominion: The Black Iron Court turns Gate wounds into bargains, proving ambition can defend a Realm only when power accepts consequence. It directly tests the faction tension: They can weaponize catastrophe better than any Realm, but every alliance with them asks who will hold the chain afterward.
terrain: black iron court with volcanic glass aisles and ember chain channels

objectives.primary: Hold two Infernal Dominion objective markers while the Cinders of Dominion conflict escalates. Elite remix: complete it while the secondary hazard condition is active.
optional: Resolve at least three Infernal Dominion doctrine actions
Hold every objective for one full enemy turn

reinforcement from the Gate wound flank
